# Fixture whose seal says online-first and nothing else

This is the discriminating fixture for the 2026-09-07 change. Until then the words
online-first / no doi / preprint / ahead-of-print in the seal's prose took a note out of C-B
for good; now they do nothing and the note counts until someone writes a dated check18_exempt
or the missing fields. Revert the logic and this counter drops by one.
